FolderProgress.title: Folder Progress
FolderProgress.description: Summary of photo culling progress for a specific Google Drive folder owned by a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the folder culling owner.

folderName.description: Display name of the Google Drive folder.

keepCount.description: Count of files marked to keep.

trashCount.description: Count of files currently queued for deletion.

lastShotId.description: File ID of the last viewed photo in this folder for exact resume.

lastShotName.description: Filename of the last viewed photo in this folder for exact resume.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last progress update.

DecisionChunk.title: Decision Chunk
DecisionChunk.description: Deterministic shard holding photo culling decisions for a Google Drive folder.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

entries.description: Map keyed by Drive fileId containing decision, file metadata, batchId, and updatedAtMs.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last shard update.

SeriesCalibrationPreference.title: Series Calibration Preference
SeriesCalibrationPreference.description: Global user preference holding adaptive visual similarity calibration weights and labeled examples across all folders.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

baseSensitivity.description: Base sensitivity preset used alongside calibrated metrics.

calibration.description: Fitted multi-gate visual similarity calibration thresholds.

examples.description: Bounded list of labeled photo comparison metric pairs (same/different).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last calibration sync.

ManualLockedSeriesDoc.title: Manual Locked Series
ManualLockedSeriesDoc.description: User-edited and locked photo series for a specific Drive folder that overrides automatic grouping.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

shotIds.description: Ordered list of shot IDs locked into this series.

stems.description: Ordered list of filename stems locked into this series.

updatedAtMs.description: Client epoch timestamp in milliseconds of the manual edit.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the manual series save.

/users/{userId}/folders/{folderId}.description: Stores folder-level culling summary counts for the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/folders/{folderId}/chunk.description: Stores sharded per-file culling decisions (keep/trash) for a folder.

/users/{userId}/folders/{folderId}/manua.description: Stores immutable user-edited locked series per Drive folder.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Stores global continuous visual similarity calibration preferences per user.
